Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is a good win, but far from the advertised top prize.

Tomorrow's count on "Bingo 50X" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
847.headline: No $500,000 prize is left

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" is near the end of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Tomorrow's count on "Cash Explosion 25X" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
891.headline: Early stage or late
